annotations.title: utilpeek: convert subtitles between SRT, WebVTT and JSON

description: utilpeek: Convert subtitles between SRT, WebVTT and JSON, with a time shift. To make subtitles from audio use transcribe_audio. Returns a subtitle file converted between SRT, WebVTT and a JSON segment list [{start, end, text}] (seconds, as /v1/audio/transcribe returns it), with an optional time shift in milliseconds. Strict parsing: the input format is detected, a malformed cue is named in a 422. At most 1,000,000 characters and 10,000 cues. Malformed subtitles (bad timing line, end before start, empty cue, over the limits) are a 422 naming the cue (not charged). A negative shift clamps starts at 0 and drops cues that end before 0. Typically under 0.3 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/subtitle-converter-api.html

end.description: End in seconds, not before start.
end.title: End

content.description: The SRT or WebVTT file as text (at most 1,000,000 characters, 10,000 cues). The format is detected from a WEBVTT header unless from_format is given. Use this or segments.
content.title: Content

from_format.description: Optional input format check: content is srt or vtt, segments are json.
from_format.title: From Format

segments.description: A JSON segment list [{start, end, text}] in seconds, as /v1/audio/transcribe returns it. Use this or content.
segments.title: Segments

shift_ms.description: Time shift in milliseconds for every cue (negative = earlier; a cue that ends before 0 is dropped).
shift_ms.title: Shift Ms

to.description: Output format: srt (SubRip), vtt (WebVTT) or json (a list of {start, end, text}, seconds).
to.title: To

name: convert_subtitles

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
